items.title: People's Pension joins TISA to focus on vulnerable members
items.summary: The defined contribution master trust has joined TISA's Vulnerable Customers Working Group.

items.title: FCA spent £70,000 on Emil the Seal scam awareness campaign at London Waterloo
items.summary: Investment Week has revealed that the Financial Conduct Authority spent seventy thousand pounds on an ATM pop-up scam awareness campaign at London Waterloo station in January 2026.

items.title: Professional Pensions launches survey on AI use in pension schemes
items.summary: Professional Pensions has launched a weekly survey asking industry professionals if their schemes will expand artificial intelligence use following guidance from The Pensions Regulator.

items.title: DHL Group Retirement Plan appoints Capital Cranfield chair
items.summary: Capital Cranfield's Lukshmi Selvarajah has taken over as trustee chair of the £6bn pension scheme.

items.title: AM Best revises outlooks to positive for International General Insurance
items.summary: AM Best has revised the Long-Term Issuer Credit Rating outlooks to positive from stable for International General Insurance Holdings Ltd and its subsidiaries.

items.title: Howden Re advises insurers to pair catastrophe models with independent risk analysis
items.summary: Reinsurance intermediary Howden Re has urged insurers and reinsurers to combine updated catastrophe models with independent risk analysis to properly distinguish between actual risk shifts and modelling assumption changes.
